status: registered before any H59 implementation, fit, holdout score or artifact

data_integrity.required_action: verify every manifest member by SHA-256 and byte count before any computation; fail closed on mismatch
data_integrity.qualification: owner-supplied integrity-pinned mirror; NOT organizer-authenticated (IR-52-003, IR-H58-001)
data_integrity.tracked_data_policy: tracked data/*.tif rasters are never read by H59
data_integrity.sample_template_policy: sample_submission.tif supplies CRS/shape/transform and its finite domain only; cell values are never used
data_integrity.forbidden_predictor: no label-derived distance field, no prior prediction values, no leaderboard score enters any H59 field

views.learner: L2 logistic C=1.0, class_weight balanced, lbfgs, 60k positives and 60k negatives per fit
views.encoding: global min-max rank to uint8 over the all-band-valid footprint
views.band_6_note: band 6 is measured radiometric total count (IR-52-019, evidence/h53_band6_identity.json), so it belongs to View B

oof.purpose: strata, independence blocks, pseudo-label segments, artifact fields (full footprint coverage)
oof.structure: 4 contiguous quadrants; whole 8-connected catalogue components by majority quadrant; 4 px collar; out-of-fold predictions kept inside the held quadrant

evaluation.purpose: hide-and-recover and block comparisons; every arm refits both views per fold
evaluation.structure: gems52.h58.make_folds; whole components; prevalence 0.002 of each fold's scored region; block mode quarantines crossing components; 80 px Euclidean collar

report: median depth to basement per stratum

pseudo_label_exchange.role: diagnostic only; can never alter the shipped field
pseudo_label_exchange.segment_rule: whole 8-connected segments, >= 5 px, entirely inside one 50x50 block, entirely inside the unlabelled region, no catalogue or corridor pixel, >= 80 px from evaluation pixels
pseudo_label_exchange.auc_negatives: catalogue-zero proxy negatives >= 500 m EUCLIDEAN from every catalogue pixel (fixes IR-H58-003)

candidate_slate.name: surface-artifact veto on the union field
candidate_slate.field: max(p_A, p_B) ranked on the legal pool minus the B-only stratum
candidate_slate.signature: linear surface lineaments (roads, levees, erosion lines) that View B alone rates confident
candidate_slate.why_catalogue_missing: removes false-positive tax while dual-view catalogue-missing faults keep their union rank
candidate_slate.difference: H57 registered --veto-b-only but never measured it

candidate_slate.name: agreement-weighted product rank
candidate_slate.signature: both independent views warm (Blum-Mitchell high-precision agreement set)
candidate_slate.why_catalogue_missing: highest-precision off-catalogue candidates; single-view-hot pixels are each view's artifact family
candidate_slate.difference: H57's field was max(p_A, p_B); product never measured as a ranking field

candidate_slate.name: basement-step buttress field
candidate_slate.field: rank(grad band 15) * rank(grad band 13), restricted to band-15 value rank >= 128 (at-or-above-median cover)
candidate_slate.signature: lateral basement-depth steps collocated with gravity-gradient ridges under thick cover
candidate_slate.why_catalogue_missing: basin-bounding faults under alluvial cover have no surface trace for the map to draw
candidate_slate.difference: depth-to-basement was only ever a passive classifier feature; H57-D conductivity-depth contrast was registered and never run

candidate_slate.name: seismicity-lineament field
candidate_slate.why_catalogue_missing: blind faults with microseismicity but no surface rupture
candidate_slate.difference: band 10 never in any view; band 16 never a ranking transform

candidate_slate.name: multi-scale potential-field residual ratio
candidate_slate.field: short-wavelength residual of bands 13/2 over a fixed broad regional, normalized
candidate_slate.signature: narrow basement block edges under cover
candidate_slate.why_catalogue_missing: shallow basement faulting shows as short-wavelength gravity texture
candidate_slate.difference: H58-B registered, never run; no multi-scale transform in this checkout; nearest cousin H55-EDGE failed its gate
candidate_slate.queued_reason: nearest implemented cousin (H55-EDGE gravity LoG) failed its promotion gate; queued behind cheaper candidates

baselines: random control (rebuilt per budget, same legal pool)
arms.block_budget_scaling: primary/secondary scaled by the fold legal-share of the footprint
arms.emitter: gems52.h57.iso_select, isotropic 3 px minimum separation, NMS 5
arms.emission_pool: valid footprint AND sample-submission finite domain AND NOT the <= 200 m catalogue ring

field_decision_rule.eligibility: beat the random control on >= 3/4 folds in BOTH modes at the primary budget
field_decision_rule.shippable_fields: view_A, view_B, union, product, vetoB, basestep, seismicity (the a_only_stratum arm is a labelled diagnostic and random is a control; neither can ship)
field_decision_rule.shipped: eligible shippable field with the highest mean hide-DTI at the primary budget; ties broken by block mean, then simplicity (single view < union < product/vetoB < layer fields)
field_decision_rule.if_independence_abandoned: shipped field is the best single view
field_decision_rule.if_no_candidate_beats_union: union ships and candidates are recorded as refutations
field_decision_rule.no_post_hoc_tuning: no threshold, weight or parameter may change after any holdout result is seen

protocol_amendment.timing: amendment 1 before any H59 model fit; amendment 2 after the first full pipeline run reached the artifact stage and failed there, BEFORE any artifact was written or any amended number was accepted
protocol_amendment.reason: Amendment 1 (pre-fit): (a) the not-the-union gate forbids equality with the view_A emission, the view_B emission, or their set-union; equality with the union FIELD's own emission is reported, not gated; (b) the a_only_stratum arm is a diagnostic and can never be the shipped field. Amendment 2 (emission-capacity fix): the registered emitter reference 'h57.iso_select, isotropic 3 px minimum separation, NMS 5' includes an NMS-5 prefilter that is a speed approximation INSIDE that function, not part of the 3 px separation rule; on a smooth probability field it caps the emission below the registered budget (measured: 27,905 nodes against the 37,654 request on the View-B field), violating the registration's own 'exactly 37,654 nodes' requirement. The emitter is therefore replaced by the exact greedy under the same inclusive 3 px separation (gems52.h59.iso_select_exact), applied IDENTICALLY to every arm, every control comparison and the artifact. The capacity failure was discovered as a hard error at the artifact stage; no DTI number motivated the change and no threshold, weight, ranking or pool rule changed. The entire pipeline (OOF, independence, strata, exchange, both holdout instruments, decision, artifact, gates) was rerun end-to-end under the amended emitter, so no pre-amendment measurement survives into the H59 receipts; the superseded run's fold log is preserved in the repository history.

artifact.values: exactly {0, 1} float32; 0 NaN/Inf anywhere; zeros outside the emission
artifact.grid: EPSG:32611, 3292x3730 at 100 m, exact competition transform
artifact.no_pixel_copied: every emitted cell is computed from the H59 fields on this staging; no prior raster is read into any emission mask

gates.format: single band float32, EPSG:32611, exact transform/shape, values in [0,1], all finite, all emitted inside the valid footprint
gates.uniqueness: decoded pattern differs from every accessible aligned prior; inventory scope disclosed
gates.not_the_union: decoded pattern differs from the same-budget iso-emissions of view_A and view_B and from the SET-UNION of those two emissions; the comparison against the union-field's own emission is REPORTED but is not a gate, because max(p_A, p_B) is itself the round's co-training combination -- the forbidden thing is lazily taking the union of the two views' separate emissions
gates.ring: minimum distance to a mapped catalogue pixel > 200 m
gates.novelty_reporting: support-novelty fraction vs prior support union and overlap with the 0.2778 reference reported as numbers, no threshold
gates.reasoning: one row per emitted pixel; written geological reasoning plus explicit falsifier for every A-only pixel
gates.shippable_fields: view_A, view_B, union, product, vetoB, basestep, seismicity; a_only_stratum is a diagnostic arm and is never the shipped field; random is a control

slot_verdict_rule.recommended: all gates pass AND shipped field beats the strongest same-fold single-view baseline by >= +0.003 mean DTI on BOTH instruments at primary budget with >= 3/4 strict fold wins on both AND full-budget emission on every primary fold AND independence gate did not abandon the method
slot_verdict_rule.otherwise: research only - do not spend a slot; print the failing numbers
slot_verdict_rule.caveat_always_printed: owner-mirror provenance; local holdout is not organizer validation
